title: Question 10
passage:
Do you want the new staff handbook bound, or should we send the pages loose?
A. Our printer is beside the reception desk. B. The new staff start on Wednesday. C. Loose, please. We'll be changing just the contact page next week.
passageZh:
新版員工手冊要裝訂，還是把頁面散裝寄過去？
A. 印表機在接待櫃台旁。 B. 新員工星期三到職。 C. 散裝就好。我們下星期只會換聯絡資料那一頁。
